The '''Zardossa Stix system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] region<ref name="EAOC" /> that contained 3 [[Moon/Legends|moons]], including the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] moon of [[Zardossa Stix/Legends|Zardossa Stix]].<ref name="The Disappeared" />
